Description: Repo, conventions and Scrum artefacts in place.
Secure login and role-based access for User, Station Master and Super Admin.
Users can find a free vehicle at a station for their time window.
Bookings with no double-booking and server-side pricing.
Station masters run rides from one dashboard.
Every payment ends in a confirmed booking or a refund.
Booking, payment and ride changes reach the right people instantly.
Payment timeouts, overtime, email and watchdogs run without manual work.
Loyalty, support tickets, reviews, favourites, booking chat and phone OTP.
Super admin controls stations, fleet, staff, customers and analytics.
Logging, CI, containers, test and operations documentation.
README skeleton, .gitignore, .editorconfig, .nvmrc (Node 20).
docs/agile/product-vision.md: vision, goals, scope, personas for User, Station Master, Super Admin.
docs/agile/product-backlog.md and user-stories.md with MoSCoW, story points and Given/When/Then acceptance criteria.
docs/agile/story-map.md: backbone Browse > Booking > Payment > Ride > Completion > Post-ride with release slices R0-R3.
docs/agile/working-agreement.md, jira-import.csv and jira-setup.md.
docs/agile/sprints/sprint-1/: planning.md, review.md, retro.md; velocity.md.
docs/agile/sprints/sprint-2/: planning.md, review.md, retro.md; velocity update.
docs/agile/sprints/sprint-3/: planning.md, review.md, retro.md; velocity update.
docs/agile/sprints/sprint-4/: planning.md, review.md, retro.md; project retrospective; final velocity table.

Summary: Backend foundation: health check, logging, config
Description: As the team, I want a health endpoint, structured logs and one place for configuration, so that containers can be health-checked and problems traced from logs. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-21).

Summary: CI pipeline: lint and build on every push
Description: As the team, I want every push and pull request to main linted and built automatically, so that broken code is caught before it is merged. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-22).
As a User, I want to create an account and log in with my email and password, so that I can book vehicles and see my bookings. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-23).

Summary: Role-based access for User / Station Master / Super Admin
Description: As a Super Admin, I want each route restricted to the roles that need it, so that customers can't reach staff or admin functions. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-24).
As a Super Admin, I want repeated requests to sensitive endpoints throttled, so that brute-force and spam attempts are blocked. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-25).
Vite + React + Tailwind + ESLint scaffold, Axios instance with auth interceptor, CI frontend job.
As a User, I want to see all EV-Go stations, so that I can choose where to pick up a vehicle. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-27).

Summary: Browse vehicles available for a time window
Description: As a User, I want to see only the vehicles free at a station for my chosen start and end time, so that I don't try to book a car that's taken. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-28).
As a Super Admin, I want to create and edit stations, so that the network matches the real locations. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-29).
As a Super Admin, I want to add, edit and remove vehicles with a photo and pricing, so that customers see an accurate fleet. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-30).
As a Super Admin, I want to create station masters and assign them to stations, so that every station is staffed before it takes bookings. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-31).
As a User, I want a list of notifications about my bookings, so that I don't miss changes even if I wasn't online. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-32).
As a User, I want to book a specific vehicle for a time slot and know it's mine, so that I can plan my trip. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-33).
As a User, I want to see my bookings and extend or shorten them, so that I can manage my plans. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-34).

Summary: Station master starts, completes and cancels rides
Description: As a Station Master, I want to start, complete or cancel a ride in one action, so that the vehicle status always matches reality. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-35).
As a Station Master, I want one dashboard for my station, so that I can see what needs doing today. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-36).

Summary: Pay for a booking with Razorpay
Description: As a User, I want to pay for my booking online, so that it's secured before I arrive. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-37).

Summary: Payment confirmed even if the browser closes (webhook)
Description: As a User, I want my booking confirmed even if I close the tab right after paying, so that I never pay without getting a booking. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-38).
As a User, I want to request a refund when I cancel and get my deposit back after a clean ride, so that I only pay for what I used. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-39).
As a Station Master, I want my dashboard to update the moment a booking or payment changes, so that I don't have to keep refreshing. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-40).
As a User, I want an email with a PDF invoice when my payment is confirmed, so that I have proof of booking. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-41).
As a Station Master, I want unpaid bookings released automatically at the deadline, so that vehicles aren't blocked by people who never pay. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-42).
As a Station Master, I want late returns billed automatically, so that I don't have to argue about late fees. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-43).
As a Super Admin, I want system-wide analytics that load instantly, so that I can report on the business without waiting. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-44).
As a User, I want to earn points on every ride and redeem them, so that I'm rewarded for renting with EV-Go. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-45).
As a User, I want to raise a support ticket and see when to expect a reply, so that problems get resolved. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-46).
As a User, I want to review vehicles I've driven and save favourites, so that I and other users can choose better. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-47).
As a User on a ride, I want to message my station and raise an emergency, so that I get help quickly. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-48).
As a User, I want to verify my phone number, so that the station can reach me about my booking. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-49).

Summary: Super admin manages customers and active rides
Description: As a Super Admin, I want to see customers and every active ride and step in when needed, so that I can deal with problems anywhere in the network. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-50).

Summary: Containerised deployment (Docker + Compose + CI image build)
Description: As the team, I want the whole stack to start with one command, the same way on every machine, so that setup and demos are reliable. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-51).

Summary: Test strategy, manual test cases, test pyramid
Description: As the team, I want a documented test approach, so that we know how quality is checked now and how automation would be added. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-52).

Summary: CD, cloud, Kubernetes and monitoring plans
Description: As the team, I want concrete plans for deployment and operations, so that we can take EV-Go to production next. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-53).
As a new developer, I want an architecture overview and a complete README, so that I can understand and run the project quickly. Acceptance criteria: docs/agile/user-stories.md (EVG-54).
